consent_exempt.APPLICATION_DISPATCH_READY: not a signing plan: `ApplicationDispatchReady.assembledReadyVerified` takes an already signed plan and its signatures and returns a Json record (`Host/ApplicationDispatchReady.lean:138`, type `IO Json`); nothing is signed after it. Named *_READY, listed here so the registry check does not read the suffix as a plan
consent_exempt.AUTHORIZED_PREPARE: the member's own ordinary signing plan: every submit routes it through the local consent provider's frame 222 (NativeClientConsent.checkIntentPlan against the retained intent), not through the operator-plan list; listed here so the check knows it is covered elsewhere
consent_exempt.PLATFORM_INSTALL_PLAN: Host-stdio platform route (no socket route yet); the signer is the deployment's factory controller through its operator tooling, not a member; not routed through the local consent provider. consent_exempt.METER_REFILL_PLAN: Host-stdio meter route (no socket route yet); the signer is the deployment's factory controller through its operator tooling, not a member; not routed through the local consent provider. Owed as for PLATFORM_INSTALL_PLAN
